summary: Physical UI45 acceptance follow-up: removes separators from monitored rows, matches accepted native card font/size, makes the entire composed host or built-in family card one accessible native click/keyboard target for the canonical object drawer; keeps grouped custom mixed-source cards' own drilldowns. Does not alter public telemetry, viewer interest, Core or canonical snapshots. Live-series oscillation remains independently tracked in Core #402 because the existing 1Hz viewer-aware transport already powers graph and cards; fixing actual producer sampling must be qualified in Core, not hidden by an arbitrary UI stale timeout. Supersedes signed UI45 dev, preserves beta UI42 and stable.
